# Sedat Okutan

> Sedat Okutan is an independent software developer based in İzmir, Türkiye. He builds web platforms, online communities, developer tools and mobile games, handling everything from design and code to launch and community growth. okutan.org is his personal developer site (Turkish and English).

Contact: sedat@okutan.org — open to freelance work and collaboration, usually replies within 24 hours.

## Live projects

- [LaunchShots](https://launchshots.app/): Free, browser-based screenshot designer for the App Store and Google Play. 11 device frames, 25 languages, zoom callouts and annotations, store-ready ZIP export. No sign-up, no watermark. Built with JavaScript and Canvas.
- [Kelimeler: Online Kelime Oyunu](https://okutan.org/kelimeler/): Social, competitive online word game made for Turkish, on iPhone and Android: 60,000+ words, city battles across 81 provinces, daily puzzle and quick-play modes. The new version of his Android word game that reached a 4.8 rating on Google Play.
  - [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kelimeler-online-kelime-oyunu/id6775899635)
  - [Android](https://okutan.org/kelimeler/android.html)
  - [Support](https://okutan.org/kelimeler/support.html)
- [Balon Patlat](https://okutan.org/balon/): Free browser bubble shooter game (Turkish/English) with an online daily, weekly and all-time leaderboard. No download, no sign-up. Built with HTML5 Canvas, PHP and MySQL.
- [Sebze.net](https://www.sebze.net/): Turkish community for hobby gardening and growing vegetables. Built on XenForo with custom development, including his own image-rating add-on.
- [Kitaplar.org](https://www.kitaplar.org/): Turkish book platform for book discovery, recommendations and a reader community, with search, categories and content management.

## Past work

Android games and apps he previously published on Google Play (no longer available on the store): Kelimeler: Türkçe Bulmaca (multiplayer word game, 4.8★), WOW3: Word Connect, Associations: Kelime Bul, Blokları Patlat, Sidik Yarışı, Ezan Vakti — Namaz & Kıble, Zikirmatik — Tesbih, Photo Recovery: Pro.

## Skills

- Web: JavaScript, PHP, XenForo, HTML/CSS, Canvas API, MySQL
- Mobile and games: Kotlin, Flutter, Unity, LibGDX
